tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a web page URL and convert it to clean Markdown optimized for LLM context. Preserves headings, code blocks (with language hints), links, and tables; strips ads, navigation, and cookie banners. For Mintlify docs (docs.anthropic.com, OpenAI platform, Vercel, Stripe, etc.) tries the `URL.md` convention first for cleanest output. Discovers tab groups statically and emits each panel as a `### Tab: {label}` section instead of concatenating (prevents Python+TypeScript examples merging into one broken block). Zero external API calls — parses locally via linkedom.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the web page to convert. Blocks private ranges, loopback, and cloud metadata endpoints.

include_images.description: Include image references (![alt](src)) in the output.

include_frontmatter.description: Prepend a YAML frontmatter block with title, source URL, capture timestamp, language, description, and canonical URL.

timeout_ms.description: Abort the fetch after N milliseconds. Range: 1000-60000.
